title: Farewell cake near Schofields or Marsden Park? 100% eggless, ready in 2 days
summary: Need a farewell cake for a colleague near Schofields or Marsden Park? Order 2 days ahead and we will have it ready at Num Num's Bakery, Riverstone Shopping Centre. Every cake is 100% eggless, so nobody on the team has to ask what is in it. Pick up from 6am on weekdays, before the office fills up, with free parking at the centre. Add the name and a short message on the cake. Choose from 15 flavours, with 6-inch cakes from $39.99.
